notificationsSettings.needsInputTitle: Notify me when a session needs input
notificationsSettings.needsInputDescription: Raise a desktop notification when a session is blocked on you — a permission prompt, a question — and the lich window is not the one you are in. While you are in lich nothing changes: the card's bell and the toast do the telling.
notificationsSettings.needsInputLabel: Raise a desktop notification when a session needs input
notificationsSettings.finishedTitle: Notify me when a session finishes working
notificationsSettings.finishedDescription: Raise a desktop notification when a session ends its turn with nothing left to ask you, and the lich window is not the one you are in. Independent of the setting above — a long run you walked away from is worth knowing about even if you would rather not hear about every prompt. No toast comes with it: inside lich, the card and its project tab already say so.
notificationsSettings.finishedLabel: Raise a desktop notification when a session finishes working

closeSetting.description: What lich does with its sessions when you close its window. With none running, closing the window quits lich.

ask.consequence: lich asks each time whether to keep running in the background.

background.label: Keep running
background.consequence: The window closes and the sessions keep working; opening lich again brings them back.

quit.label: Quit
quit.consequence: Closing the window ends lich and every session in it.

resume.label: Resume
resume.consequence: Restored cards continue their conversation on open. For an empty one, open a new session.
